decisions.title: [solar/forecast] The numbers uploaded for solar do not add up. They differ by 27.27% from what ph
decisions.what: The numbers uploaded for solar do not add up. They differ by 27.27% from what physics expects (allowed difference is only ±7%). Either wrong data was uploaded or power is leaking somewhere.
decisions.why: The uploaded production, storage and distribution numbers contradict each other beyond the small errors we tolerate.
decisions.how: The AI compared the uploaded numbers with physics-based expected values and the gap was far too large to be a typing error. The AI is 82% sure about this.

decisions.solution: Demand uploader explanation; freeze settlement until data reconciled.
